page: Amazon Web Services c9gd.2xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. Powered by custom 64-bit Arm-based AWS Graviton processors operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, it features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, resulting in 8 vCPUs. The server is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

For local data access, the instance provides 474 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volume capacity. Network infrastructure delivers a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps. The instance contains no graphics acceleration hardware and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The ARM-based architecture combined with dedicated physical cores offers reliable processing density for compute-bound tasks. The integration of high-speed local NVMe storage reduces latency for scratch disk operations, though data stored on instance store volumes is ephemeral. The 2.0 GB memory allocation per core necessitates workloads tailored for higher CPU utilization relative to RAM requirements.

The hardware profile suits high-performance computing, video encoding, web serving clusters, software build jobs, and temporary caching databases that leverage high single-thread density and fast local storage.
